quick_mode.description: Light mode (kept for backward compat). Active when the `p-express` agent is selected in the agents dropdown — no prefix required.
quick_mode.note: Single source of truth for trivial vs non-trivial is the threshold table in phase-2-planning.md. Do NOT duplicate rules here — this block is a pointer only and must not diverge.

guard_hooks.description: Informational mirror of the executable hooks in .github/hooks/phase-gates.json (sessionStart injects routing context, preToolUse enforces Phase 2 approval, postToolUse reminds lint/format, sessionEnd/errorOccurred point back to phases/README.md). This file is a prompt-routing convention, NOT executable automation — Copilot loads hooks only from .github/hooks/*.json; see .github/hooks/report-lifecycle.sh (run on demand via npm run reports*) for the on-demand automation script.

workflow_phase_config.description: Defines which phases each workflow type executes. Code-delivery workflows run all 5 phases. Analysis-only workflows (Jira Ticket Investigate, Code Review) skip Phases 2-4.

jira-ticket-investigate.note: Analysis-only workflow. Only Phase 1 (understand) and Phase 5 (report) apply. No planning, execution, or validation needed.

code-review.note: Review-only workflow. Only Phase 1 (understand context) and Phase 5 (report) apply. No planning, execution, or PR validation needed.

unit-test.note: Full 5-phase code-delivery workflow (Phase 3 writes test code).

sessionStart.description: Load the hook index and phase-appropriate guidance before work begins.
Load workflow guidance, investigate context, and apply stack rules before planning.

sessionEnd.description: Run build and tests, and prepare PR output.
Generate final report, sync Jira, and run post-merge sync (step 11) once the PR is confirmed merged.

userPromptSubmitted.description: Create a draft plan and apply the approval-gate convention for non-trivial requests.
Execute approved plan, update tests, and run lint/format checks.

preToolUse.description: Before read/search/context tools, verify guidance loading and rule application are complete.
Before code-edit tools, verify a draft plan has been presented; for non-trivial requests, ensure explicit developer approval.

postToolUse.description: After implementation steps, run lint/format checks.

errorOccurred.description: On errors, return to phase index, re-align phase order, and resume from the failing phase.
